name: $bodyHas
description: Checks if the request body contains a key.

args.name: Key
args.description: The key to check in the body.

name: $bodyLength
description: Returns the number of top-level keys in the request body.

name: $getBodyProp
description: Gets a property from the request body.

name: $getRawBody
description: Gets the raw request body as a string.

name: $isJsonBody
description: Returns true if the request body is valid JSON.

name: $loadBodyTo
description: Loads the parsed request body into an environment variable.

args.name: Name
args.description: The environment variable name to assign the request body to.

name: $validateBodySchema
description: Validates the request body against a JSON schema.

args.name: Schema
args.description: The JSON schema to validate against.

name: $getAllHeaders
description: Returns all request headers as a JSON object.

name: $getHeader
description: Retrieves a header from the request. Returns an empty string if not found.

name: $hasHeader
description: Checks if a specific header exists in the request.

name: $hasHeaderValue
description: Checks if a header has a specific value.

name: $listHeaderKeys
description: Lists all header keys in the request.

name: $removeHeader
description: Removes a header from the response.

args.name: Key
args.description: The name of the header to remove.

name: $setHeader
description: Sets a custom response header.

name: $setHtmlHeader
description: Sets Content-Type: text/html on the response.

name: $getAllQueryParams
description: Returns all query parameters as a JSON object.

name: $getQuery
description: Retrieves a query parameter from the request. Returns an empty string if not found.

name: $hasQueryParam
description: Checks if a query parameter exists in the request.

args.name: Key
args.description: The name of the query parameter.

name: $queryLength
description: Returns the number of query parameters in the request.

name: $setJsonHeader
description: Sets Content-Type: application/json on the response.

name: $accepts
description: Returns accepted content types as a comma-separated string.

name: $baseURL
description: Retrieves the base URL of the request. Returns empty string if unavailable.

name: $hostname
description: Retrieves the hostname from the request. Returns an empty string if unavailable.

name: $ip
description: Retrieves the IP address of the incoming request. Returns an empty string if unavailable.

name: $isRequestSecure
description: Checks if the incoming request was made over HTTPS.

name: $originalURL
description: Retrieves the full original URL of the incoming request.

name: $referrer
description: Returns the Referer header value from the request.

name: $userAgent
description: Returns the user-agent string of the request.

name: $end
description: Ends the response without sending any content.

name: $redirect
description: Redirects the response to the given URL.

name: $sendJson
description: Sends a JSON response with the given data.

name: $sendText
description: Sends plain text in a response, with an optional status code.

args.name: Status Code
args.description: The status code to send with the response.

name: $setStatus
description: Sets the HTTP status code for the response.
